name: mulHeight_eval_le
statement: ℕ} {p : ι' → MvPolynomial ι K} (hp : ∀ i, (p i).IsHomogeneous N) (x : ι → K) : mulHeight (fun j ↦ (p j).eval x) ≤ max (mulHeightBound p) 1 * mulHeight x ^ N
